title: Render the Windows shell section into the managed block on a PowerShell host
action: Add packages/bee/AGENTS.windows.md carrying the Windows Environment section (two-shell split: the user's own terminal is PowerShell, the agent's Bash tool and anything the user types with the ! prefix is Git Bash; default to PowerShell for commands handed to the user; the three silent breakers — forward-slash paths in Bash-tool commands, CRLF needing \r?$, and NTFS exec-bit/symlink semantics with bee probing both .bee/bin/bee and .bee/bin/bee.exe). Register it in onboard/source.rs Engine as agents_windows_template beside agents_block_template. In onboard/merge.rs give render_agents_block a second parameter — the optional Windows template path, Some only when the host resolves to powershell — and append that file's trimmed body inside the SAME managed block, one blank line after the main body, before MARKER_END; None renders byte-identically to today. Add a resolver (host_shell_is_powershell) reading .bee/config.json's host_shell key: "powershell" true, "posix" false, absent or unrecognised falls back to cfg!(windows). Wire it at the plan.rs:352 call site. Tests: the absent-config posix host renders exactly today's bytes; host_shell=powershell renders the section inside the markers; host_shell=posix on a windows-cfg host suppresses it; an unrecognised value falls back rather than refusing; and the appended block still round-trips through agents_block_present/extract_agents_block so onboarding reports up_to_date on a second run. Adding a shipped file means running bee dev release-manifest --write in this cell.
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml onboard && .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check

truths: A posix host renders the managed block byte-identically to today
A powershell host renders the Windows section inside the same markers
The .bee/config.json host_shell key wins over host detection in both directions
An unrecognised host_shell value falls back to host detection, never refuses
onboard reports up_to_date on a second run with the section present
The release manifest is regenerated and --check is clean
The full declared test suite is green

trace.outcome: onboarding appends the Windows Environment section inside the managed AGENTS.md block when host_shell resolves to powershell; .bee/config.json wins over host detection
trace.inline_reason: Solo session, single cell, no sibling worker to conflict with; the routing deviation to small was already recorded on the route for file count alone, and dispatching one worker for a 60-line change would cost more than it protects
